statement: Boundary-role MOP identities will be associated with semantically same-system neighboring components across genomes more often than expected under the matched token-assignment null.
support_condition: S_C3 above null mean and one-sided 100,000-replicate Monte Carlo tail <=0.05; strong support <=0.01.
weakening_condition: S_C3 above null mean but tail >0.05.
contamination_boundary: Frozen before candidate neighboring gene symbols, products, EC numbers, or C3 match counts were extracted or inspected.
